module: Vehicle catalog and spawning on the GE side. It reads the /vehicles/<model>/ folders (info.json, .pc files, images, paints, jbeam) to build the list of models and configurations with their filtering aggregates (cache invalidated when files change), and provides the functions to spawn/replace/delete vehicles (including multi-vehicle configurations, .pc format 4: trailers, etc.). It also tracks the couplings (hitches) between vehicles, the "vehicle collections" (main vehicle + trailers to be repositioned together), who drives which vehicle (vehiclePlayersMap) and the license plate. A modder uses it to list the models (getModelList, getConfig), spawn or replace a car (spawnNewVehicle, replaceVehicle) and change the plate (setPlateText).
usage:
-- spawn a pickup with its default configuration, then change the plate
local veh = core_vehicles.spawnNewVehicle('pickup', {config = 'd15_4wd_A', autoEnterVehicle = true})
if veh then core_vehicles.setPlateText('BEAM-123', veh:getID()) end

-- read a model's info
local m = core_vehicles.getModel('etk800')
print(m.model.Name, tableSize(m.configs))
notes: Format of getModel(key): {model = table of model info (Name, Brand, Type, preview, logo, key, default_pc, paints, aggregates...), configs = table keyed by configuration key (Name, key, model_key, preview, aggregates, pcFilename...)}. An unknown key returns {} (and logs an error).

The result of getModel is cached (clearCache empties everything). The cache is invalidated automatically by onFileChanged/onFileChangedEnd if a .json, .jbeam, .pc, .jpg or .png file under /vehicles/ or /mods/ changes, and by onLanguageChanged.
The default model (defaultVehicleModel) is 'pickup', or 'etk800' if beamng_appname contains 'tech'.

Usual spawn options (opt): config (name or .pc path, or table in format 4), model, paint/paint2/paint3, pos, rot, licenseText, vehicleName, autoEnterVehicle (true by default for the first vehicle, false for the following vehicles of a collection), canSpawnAnotherVehicleCheck (false to ignore the limit), safeSpawn, additionalVehicleData.

Vehicle collections: vehCollections[mainId] = {mainVehData, vehsData, resetState...}; initVehCollections keeps the initial state; vehIdToVehCollection finds a vehicle's collection. The tables are rebuilt (buildVehCollectionCache) after onDeserialized, and vehsData is removed before serialization.

Plate: the text is stored in the vehicle's dynData (licenseText, licenseDesign, licenseFormats). A double quote '"' makes the text invalid (isLicensePlateValid). The text is truncated to design.vars.plate.maxLength (32 by default), counting UTF-8 characters. If the file settings/cloud/forceLicencePlate.txt exists, its content is used as the text.
Bug: M.removeAllWithProperty = removeAllWithProperty references a local variable that is never defined: the field is nil.

Bug: in spawnNewVehicle, `opt.canSpawnAnotherVehicleCheck` is read before `opt = deepcopy(opt) or {}`: calling spawnNewVehicle(model) without an opt table causes a Lua error (replaceVehicle does not have this problem because the copy is made beforehand).
spawnNewVehicle returns false if the vehicle limit is reached, nil if the model or the spawn fails, otherwise (first vehicle, list of all created vehicles).

The default vehicle loading code in VariableRegistry (loadDefaultVehicle, etc.) is commented out or in a commented block: "no longer used". getDefaultVehicleParams remains exported and reads parseArgs.args.vehicleConfig, $beamngVehicleArgs and the default collection file.
extractProperties and extractVehicles are development tools (printing of translation keys, list of configurations whose .pc paints do not match info): they are not used in game.

The keys listed in getAttributesWhiteList (Drivetrain, Type, Transmission, Country, Value, Brand...) are the attributes aggregated for the filters; getAttributesConvertToRange and getAttributesConvertToDict indicate which ones are converted to a range (Value, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h...) or to a dictionary (Region, InsuranceClass).

attachedCouplers.desc: List of currently attached couplings: {vehicleId1, vehicleId2, node1, node2}. Updated by onCouplerAttached/onCouplerDetached.

couplerTagsOptions.desc: Known coupler tags (tow_hitch, fifthwheel, gooseneck_hitch, pintle = 'autoCouple'; fifthwheel_v2 = true).

defaultVehicleModel.desc: Default model: 'pickup' (or 'etk800' for the tech version).

finalRanges.desc: Attributes that the interface must read as ranges (Years, Value, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Weight/Power, Off-Road Score).

initVehCollections.desc: Vehicle collections in their initial state, keyed by main vehicle id.

initVehIdToVehCollection.desc: Vehicle id -> initial collection (defined but not populated in this file).

playerVehicleMap.desc: Player index -> id of the vehicle they occupy.

resetVehCollectionEnabled.desc: true: re-enables repositioning of vehicle collections on reset (serialized).

vehCollections.desc: Current vehicle collections, keyed by main vehicle id.

vehIdToVehCollection.desc: Vehicle id -> collection it belongs to.

vehiclePersonaMap.desc: Vehicle id -> persona (profile) id of the player occupying it.

vehiclePlayersMap.desc: Vehicle id -> set of indexes of the players occupying it.

vehsCouplerCache.desc: [vehicleId][nodeId] = copy of the coupler node data (couplerTag, tag, cid...).

vehsCouplerOffset.desc: [vehicleId][nodeId] = vec3 offset of the coupler node relative to the reference node.

vehsCouplings.desc: Adjacency of coupled vehicles: vehsCouplings[id][otherId] = true.

changeMeshVisibility.desc: Called by the mesh visibility keys: changes the transparency of highlighted parts through core_vehicle_partmgmt. Do not use elsewhere.

clearCache.desc: Empties all caches (files, models, model data); they are rebuilt on demand.

cloneCurrent.desc: Spawns a copy of player 0's vehicle (same model, config, paints), emits onPlayerVehicleCloned. Refuses if there is no vehicle, if the vehicle limit is reached or if the player is walking.

returns.desc: Result of spawnNewVehicle (vehicle object) or false if refused.

convertVehicleInfo.desc: Converts an info.json to the new format: textual colors (colors) become paints (paints), old default colors (default_color...) become defaultPaintName1/2/3.

info.desc: Content of an info.json (modified in place).

createFilters.desc: Builds the interface filters (min/max range or set of possible values per attribute) from the aggregates of a list of models or configurations.

list.desc: List or dictionary of elements that have an aggregates field.

enterFreecamIfNoVehicles.desc: Switches to free camera if there is no enterable vehicle left (unless the player is the unicycle).

extractProperties.desc: Development tool: displays the property values of all models/configurations and the matching translation lines.

extractVehicles.desc: Development tool: goes through all models and configurations to compare the paints of the .pc files and of the infos.

generateAttachedVehiclesTree.desc: Builds the tree of coupled vehicles from a vehicle (parents and children through the couplings).

returns.desc: Root entry of the tree (inferred from code).

getAttributesConvertToDict.desc: List of attributes converted to a dictionary for the aggregates (Region, InsuranceClass).

getAttributesConvertToRange.desc: List of attributes converted to a range for the aggregates (Value, Weight, Top Speed, 0-100 km/h, 0-60 mph, Weight/Power, Off-Road Score).

getAttributesWhiteList.desc: List of attributes allowed as filters of the vehicle list (Drivetrain, Type, Transmission, Country, Brand, Body Style, Source...).

getConfig.desc: Returns the configuration of a model by its key.

configKey.desc: Configuration key (name of the .pc without extension).

getConfigList.desc: Lists all configurations of all models, with the associated filters.

array.desc: true: list as an array; otherwise keyed by "model_key".

getCouplerOffset.desc: Offset (x, y, z) of a vehicle's coupler nodes relative to its reference node, filtered by tag.

couplerTag.desc: Tag searched for (couplerTag or tag); empty or nil = all.

returns.desc: Table keyed by node id: {x, y, z, couplerTag, tag}.

getCurrentVehicleDetails.desc: Details of player 0's vehicle (equivalent to getVehicleDetails(be:getPlayerVehicleID(0))). You can also use playerVehicle:getJBeamFilename().

returns.desc: {current = {key, pc_file, position, color, config_key}, model, configs, userDefault}

getDefaultVehicleParams.desc: Determines the default vehicle to launch at startup: vehicleConfig command-line argument, otherwise $beamngVehicleArgs, otherwise the default configuration of the vehicles folder, otherwise the pickup (or etk800).

returns.desc: {model, {config = .pc path}} or true/nil depending on the case (heterogeneous return value).

getFilesJson.desc: Cache of the vehicles' info JSON files (computed on the first call).

returns.desc: List of file paths (inferred from code).

getFilesParsed.desc: Cache of the JSON/PC files already read, keyed by path (e.g. /vehicles/pickup/info.json).

getModel.desc: All the info of a model: model sheet, configurations, paints, previews, aggregates. Result cached. An invalid name (non-string) returns {}; an unknown model logs an error and returns {}.

returns.desc: {model = table, configs = table<string, table>}, or {} if not found.

getModelList.desc: List of all available models with the filters and display information.

array.desc: true: array; otherwise table keyed by model key.

getModelsData.desc: Scans /vehicles and returns the models found with their files (info, .pc, jbeam, images). Result cached until clearCache.

getPaintFiles.desc: Cache of the paint files found.

getVehicleDetails.desc: Details of a vehicle: model key, .pc file, position, color, configuration key, model and configuration sheet.

returns.desc: {current = {key, pc_file, position, color, config_key}, model, configs, userDefault (true if the .pc is the user's default config)}

getVehicleLicenseText.desc: Current plate text of a vehicle (dynData licenseText).

returns.desc: Plate text, empty string without a vehicle.

getVehicleList.desc: List of vehicles (full sheets of each model) and filters, format used by the old interface (ui2).

getVehiclePersona.desc: Persona (player profile) id associated with a vehicle.

isLicensePlateValid.desc: Checks that a plate text is acceptable (nil accepted; the double quote is forbidden).

isModelListLoaded.desc: Indicates whether all models are already in the getModel cache.

returns.desc: true if the list is fully loaded.

isModelsDataLoaded.desc: Indicates whether getModelsData has already been computed.

loadCustomVehicle.desc: Writes the model and config into the $beamngVehicle and $beamngVehicleConfig variables of the VariableRegistry (startup with a given vehicle).

data.desc: Table with the config field (.pc path).

loadModelListNoGarbage.desc: Loads all models into the cache (getModel for each) without building a large list.

makeVehicleLicenseText.desc: Determines a vehicle's plate text: forced text (forceLicenceStr or file settings/cloud/forceLicencePlate.txt), text already stored (licenseText), Steam name if the useSteamName option is active in freeroam (only once), otherwise text generated by core_skiaTemplate.generateText.

veh.desc: Vehicle object or id (player 0 by default).

onCouplerAttached.desc: Hook called when a coupler attaches: records the pair in attachedCouplers and vehsCouplings.

nodeId.desc: Coupler node of the first vehicle.

obj2nodeId.desc: Coupler node of the second vehicle.

onCouplerDetached.desc: Hook called when a coupler detaches (in any way): removes the pair from the tracking tables.

onDeserialized.desc: Hook called after an extensions reload: restores the tracking tables (players, personas, couplings, collections) and rebuilds the collection caches.

onFileChanged.desc: Hook called when a file changes on disk: marks the cache as stale if the file is a .json, .jbeam, .pc, .jpg or .png under /vehicles/ or /mods/.

onFileChangedEnd.desc: Hook called after a series of file changes: empties the cache if a relevant file changed.

onInstabilityDetected.desc: Hook called when a vehicle's physics becomes unstable: if the pauseGameOnInstability setting is active (and outside multiplayer), resets the vehicle, pauses the game and sets returnData.instabilityHandled = true.

returnData.desc: Return table where instabilityHandled is set to true.

onLanguageChanged.desc: Hook called on language change: empties the cache (translated names).

onLocalParticipantsChanged.desc: Hook called when the local participants (multi-seat) change: resynchronizes the persona of each occupied vehicle.

onPersonaSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when a persona's settings change: asks the vehicles that use it to re-read their settings (onSettingsChanged on the vehicle side).

onPreVehicleSpawned.desc: Hook called before a vehicle spawns: initializes the coupling tables (couplings, couplerCache, couplerTags, couplerOffset) from the vehicle's nodes that have a couplerTag or tag, and vehiclePlayersMap.

onSerialize.desc: Hook called before an extensions reload: returns the tracking tables of players, personas, couplings and collections (without vehsData).

onSettingsChanged.desc: Hook called when settings change: the showStandalonePcs logic is frozen to true in the code (the comparison in practice only triggers on the first call).

onVehicleDestroyed.desc: Hook called when a vehicle is destroyed: removes its couplers, couplings, collections and player tracking entries.

onVehicleSwitched.desc: Hook called when a player changes vehicle: updates vehiclePlayersMap and playerVehicleMap and resynchronizes the personas.

openPartsSelectorUI.desc: Opens the parts configuration screen (route pause.vehicle.configurationcombined or vehicleconfig module). Does nothing in the main menu or without a player vehicle; may return false if the guided first drive forbids it.

returns.desc: false if refused by the first drive session.

openSelectorUI.desc: Opens the vehicle selector (new interface depending on whether pause menu V2 is used). Does nothing in the main menu.

openSelectorUI_legcay.desc: Opens the old vehicle selector (guihook MenuOpenModule 'vehicleselect'). The name contains a typo (legcay).

paintSignature.desc: JSON text identifying a paint (baseColor, clearcoat, clearcoatRoughness, metallic, roughness, to 5 decimals), useful to compare paints.

regenerateVehicleLicenseText.desc: Generates a new random plate text for a vehicle without changing the stored text.

reloadVehicle.desc: Called when a player's vehicle is reloaded: frees SteamLicensePlateVehicleId if it was that vehicle (so another one can carry the Steam name).

removeAll.desc: Deletes all vehicles; first switches to free camera if player 0 had a vehicle.

removeCurrent.desc: Deletes player 0's vehicle (logs an error if there is none); switches to free camera if there is no enterable vehicle left.

replaceVehicle.desc: Replaces a vehicle (player 0's by default) with another model/config, reusing the existing vehicle object. If no vehicle exists, creates one (subject to the limit). Deletes the remaining vehicles of the replaced collection. Called directly by the interface.

opt.desc: Spawn options (config, paint, pos, rot, licenseText, autoEnterVehicle...).

replaceWholeCollection.desc: true: reuses all vehicles of the collection (trailers).

returns.desc: First vehicle; second return: list of all. false if the vehicle limit is reached, nil on failure.

requestList.desc: Sends the list of models and configurations to the interface (guihook sendVehicleList). In career in the garage "myCars" menu, sends the inventory vehicles instead of the configurations.

requestListEnd.desc: Ends the profiling of the vehicle list (called by the interface at the end).

setMeshVisibility.desc: Called by the configuration's mesh visibility buttons: sets the transparency of highlighted parts through core_vehicle_partmgmt. Do not use elsewhere.

setPlateText.desc: Sets a vehicle's plate text, design and formats, then renders the plate textures through core_skiaTemplate (unless SkipGenerateLicencePlate, licenseNoGen or headless mode: default plate "BEAMNG"). Emits onLicensePlateChanged(txt, vehId, designPath, formats). nil values keep the current values.

txt.desc: Text (generated if nil; no double quote).

designPath.desc: Path of the .sktemplate.json (current value, then the level's design, then the default design as a fallback).

setVehiclePersona.desc: Associates a persona (profile) with a vehicle and informs the vehicle (setPlayerPersona + onSettingsChanged on the vehicle side).

persona.desc: Persona or its id (nil to remove).

returns.desc: false if the persona was already that one, true if it changed.

spawnDefault.desc: Spawns the user's default vehicle (file pathDefaultConfig) or, failing that, the game's default model; replaces the current vehicle if there is one. Emits onSpawnDefaultVehicle.

options.desc: Spawn options (config and licenseText are added).

returns.desc: Vehicle created, false if the limit is reached.

spawnNewVehicle.desc: Spawns a new vehicle (or several for a multi-vehicle configuration). Switches to the game camera if there was no player vehicle. Called directly by the interface.

opt.desc: Spawn options: config, paint, paint2, paint3, pos, rot, licenseText, vehicleName, autoEnterVehicle, canSpawnAnotherVehicleCheck, safeSpawn, additionalVehicleData... (do not pass nil, see notes).

returns.desc: First vehicle created; second return: list of all. false if limit reached, nil on failure.
